Subject: Launch Update and Next Steps

Hi Avery,

I am writing to update you on our current launch position. While our launch was tentatively scheduled for October 8, 2026, the security review—owned by Nia—will now complete on October 12 at the earliest. Because the release requires completed approval, we cannot launch on October 8. Additionally, the review may require remediation, so no new production date is authorized at this time.

That said, the team is ready to keep things moving forward, and a staging demo can still happen on October 8 using synthetic data.

Please let me know whether you choose to accept the staging demo for October 8.

Best regards,
Jordan
Engagement Lead
